question: Sachin covers a certain distance by car driving at 80 km/h and he returns to the starting point riding on a scooter at 50 km/h. Find his average speed for the whole journey up to 2 decimal places.
solution:
The correct answer is __**61.54 km/h.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Formula used- **

 
 
• Speed= Distance/Time
 
 
 
• **Given-** 
 
 
• Speed= 80Km/hr and 50 Km/hr
 
 
 
• **Calculation- **
 
 
• Let the distance be D Km. 
 
• So, time is taken to cover the distance= D/80 hr. 
 
• And, time is taken for return journey= D/50 hr. 
 
• Total time taken = (D/80) + (D/50) = (8D+5D)/(400)= 13D/400
 
• Total distance= D+D= 2D
 
• Average speed= Total distance/ Total Time taken= 2D/(13D/400)= 800/13= 61.5384 ≈ 61.54 (Ans).
